create.title: Create a tenant
create.subtitle: A tenant holds your team's work: the library of databases and workloads, runs, members and cloud keys.
create.firstBody: You're not in any tenant yet. Create your own (it takes a couple of seconds) or wait for a teammate's invitation.
create.ownedBody: You already own {{name}}. You can join any number of other tenants, but an account owns only one.
create.nameHint: The name shown everywhere for this tenant, 2 to 64 characters.
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The slug goes into console and API addresses and can't be changed later.
create.whatHappens: On creation Stroppy Cloud sets up a separate space for the tenant in Graphene and publishes the run pipelines there, and you become the owner.
